title: Controlled synthetic legal identity versus corporate family
provenance: All companies, relationships and dates in these 18 pairs are invented benchmark facts. No claims about real firms.

rules.same_legal_entity: Match only the same legal entity. Trade names and a name change without a new entity count. Separately incorporated parents, subsidiaries and sister companies are different entities.
rules.corporate_family: Match the same legal entity or entities under common corporate control at the records’ stated date. Parents, subsidiaries and sister companies under that control count. Former owners after divestiture and unrelated namesakes do not count.

model_settings.cache_policy: request hash must include rule, records and settings

record_b.name: AT
record_b.note: Trade name of Alder Tools Incorporated

source.rationale: An explicitly stated trade name of one legal entity.

record_b.name: Bay Tools LLC
record_b.note: Separate incorporated subsidiary of Alder Holdings

source.rationale: Separate legal entities under the same corporate control on the stated date.

record_a.name: Bay Metals LLC
record_a.note: Wholly owned subsidiary of Alder Holdings

record_b.name: Crest Plastics Inc
record_b.note: Separately incorporated wholly owned subsidiary of Alder Holdings

source.rationale: Sister subsidiaries are distinct legal entities in one family.
